gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: The local Linux CPU diagnostic used grayscale pixels and fixed checkpoint hashes, but submission packaging and official platform validation remain unperformed.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: The road-clearance speed envelope changed gas on 1176 decisions across twelve tune cells. The other three directions also changed actions; all arms returned valid actions.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: On registered tune 324–327 across three tracks, both selected control and stable risk envelope finished 12/12. The risk envelope was faster in all twelve paired cells; finished-lap median was 23.22 versus 24.70 seconds, with zero collisions, damage, and invalid actions. This is local tune evidence only and requires independent held-out confirmation.
